headline: Served media carries hardened headers, primary-image changes are product-scoped, and image-by-URL imports are size-capped
summary: Three defense-in-depth fixes on product media. Media assets served from storage now carry X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin, and SVG files additionally carry a content policy that prevents script from running when the file is opened directly while still rendering normally inside a product image. Setting a product's primary image now verifies the image actually belongs to the product named in the request rather than acting on the image alone. And importing a product image by URL now refuses a response larger than the same 10 MiB limit the file-upload path enforces, instead of buffering an unbounded download.

items.title: Hardened response headers on served media
items.body: Media served from storage now sets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin, so a mistyped or hostile upload can't be content-sniffed into something executable or embedded cross-origin. An SVG additionally carries a default-src 'none' sandbox content-security policy, so opening an SVG URL directly cannot run script (it still renders inside an img tag). This sits behind the existing SVG-upload sanitizer as a second layer.

items.title: Importing an image by URL is size-capped
items.body: Importing a product image from a URL now refuses a response larger than 10 MiB — the same limit a direct file upload uses — returning a clear error instead of buffering an unbounded download.

items.title: Setting the primary image is product-scoped
items.body: The endpoint that makes an image a product's primary (hero) now verifies the image belongs to the product in the request path and returns not-found otherwise, instead of acting on the image regardless of the product named. A request whose product and image don't match is now rejected.

items.title: Vendored runtime updated to v0.14.9
items.body: The vendored blamejs runtime is updated to v0.14.9, a documentation-path and source-comment fix with no API, wire-format, or behavior changes. No operator action is required.
